title: request-promise-native is deprecated
summary: npm states that request-promise-native is deprecated because it extends the deprecated request package.
replacement: Native fetch or a maintained promise-based HTTP client

constraints: Preserve request options, authentication, redirects, timeouts, transforms, full-response mode, and native-Promise rejection behavior.

steps.title: Select the target HTTP client
steps.instructions: Choose native fetch or one maintained promise-based client that covers the affected request-promise-native behavior.

steps.title: Replace request-promise-native
steps.instructions: Rewrite requests, response handling, and errors for the selected client, then remove request-promise-native.

verification.purpose: Run HTTP behavior and repository tests when defined.
